evidence: The thickness of HZO thin films with various Hf-doping concentrations grown at 220 °C on Si substrates is summarized in Table 1. It can be found that the thickness of pure ZnO film after 500 cycles is detected to be 98.3 nm. The growth per cycle (GPC) for ZnO is then calculated to be 1.97 Å/cycle. The GPC for pure HfO2 deposited at 220 °C by ALD on Si (100) is measured to be 1.0 Å/cycle. In the case of the HZO film grown with n = 40, the target thickness was calculated to be 95.8 nm. However, the measured thickness was off-target with the value of 94.9 nm. The structural properties of the deposited HZO films were analyzed by XRD. Fig. 1 shows the XRD patterns of HZO films grown on Si (100) as a function of n. The grown films are polycrystalline with a hexagonal wurtzite structure.
